description: Index IX_S (S) over F holds alpha, beta, O'Brien, a"b, abc, ABC, abd and a Null. For each case [= abc ;; = ABC ;; = alpha ;; = O'Brien ;; = ab ;; = "abc " ;; = "" ;; = Null ;; = a"b ;; = Zed ;; >= ab ;; > abc ;; < abc ;; <= abc ;; < a ;; = Long 5 ;; = *]: fresh table-type recordset, Index IX_S, Seek, read NoMatch, BOF, EOF, ID and S; MoveNext and read ID and S; MovePrevious twice and read ID and S. Asks text key equality (case, trailing space, Null, type), the index collation order, and the row each operator selects with its neighbours. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
